The word likely derives from a root meaning 'to dig' or 'hollow out,' suggesting a subterranean pit rather than a natural cave. Spanish renders it 'foso' (pit, moat), Hindi uses gupha (cave/den), Arabic jubb (pit/cistern), and Korean gul (cave/den)."
